        "contents": "import { auth } from '@/lib/auth';\nimport { prisma } from '@/lib/prisma';\nimport { checkRedemptionRateLimit, isSelfReferral, checkIPRateLimit } from '@/lib/fraud';\nimport { requireActiveMerchant } from '@/lib/merchant-status';\nimport { captureException } from '@/lib/error-tracking';\nimport { z } from 'zod';\n\nconst createRedemptionSchema = z.object({\n  voucherId: z.string(),\n  referralId: z.string().optional(),\n  method: z.enum(['online', 'in_store']),\n  orderReference: z.string().optional(),\n  amountBeforeDiscount: z.number().int().positive(),\n  discountApplied: z.number().int().nonnegative(),\n  currency: z.string(),\n});\n\nexport async function POST(req: NextRequest) {\n  try {\n    // IP-based rate limiting for public redemptions\n    const ip = req.headers.get('x-forwarded-for')?.split(',')[0] || \n               req.headers.get('x-real-ip') || \n               'unknown';\n    const ipRateLimit = checkIPRateLimit(ip, 60, 50); // 50 per hour per IP\n    if (!ipRateLimit.allowed) {\n      return NextResponse.json(\n        { error: 'Rate limit exceeded', remaining: ipRateLimit.remaining },\n        { status: 429 }\n      );\n    }\n\n    const session = await auth();\n    const body = await req.json();\n    const data = createRedemptionSchema.parse(body);\n\n    // Get voucher\n    const voucher = await prisma.voucher.findUnique({\n      where: { id: data.voucherId },\n      include: { merchant: true },\n    });\n\n    if (!voucher) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Voucher not found' }, { status: 404 });\n    }\n\n    // Check merchant is active (kill switch)\n    try {\n      await requireActiveMerchant(voucher.merchantId);\n    } catch (error) {\n      if (error instanceof Error &amp;&amp; error.message?.includes('inactive')) {\n        return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Merchant is inactive' }, { status: 403 });\n      }\n      throw error;\n    }\n\n    if (voucher.status !== 'published')\n}",

        "range": {
          "startPosition": {},
          "endPosition": {
            "line": 50

        "contents": "# How to Add a New Merchant Currency\n\nMerchants can use any ISO 4217 currency code. The system supports all currencies that JavaScript's &#96;Intl.NumberFormat&#96; supports.\n\n## Adding Currency Support\n\n1. **Set merchant currency**:\n   When creating or updating a merchant, set the &#96;defaultCurrency&#96; field to the ISO 4217 code (e.g., \"EUR\", \"GBP\", \"JPY\").\n\n2. **Currency formatting**:\n   The &#96;formatCurrency&#96; function in &#96;lib/utils.ts&#96; automatically formats currencies using the browser's locale-aware formatting:\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n   formatCurrency(5000, 'EUR') // \"€50.00\" (in en-US locale)\n   formatCurrency(5000, 'JPY') // \"¥50\" (no decimals for JPY)\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n3. **Database storage**:\n   All monetary amounts are stored in minor units (cents for USD, pence for GBP, etc.):\n   - USD: $5.00 = 500 (minor units)\n   - EUR: €5.00 = 500 (minor units)\n   - JPY: ¥50 = 50 (no minor units)\n\n4. **Voucher creation**:\n   When creating a voucher, specify the currency:\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;json\n   {\n     \"type\": \"fixed_amount\",\n     \"value\": 500,  // in minor units\n     \"currency\": \"EUR\"\n   }\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Supported Currencies\n\nAll ISO 4217 currencies are supported. Common examples:\n- USD (US Dollar)\n- EUR (Euro)\n- GBP (British Pound)\n- JPY (Japanese Yen)\n- CAD (Canadian Dollar)\n- AUD (Australian Dollar)\n- CHF (Swiss Franc)\n- CNY (Chinese Yuan)\n\n## Currency Conversion\n\nThe platform does NOT handle currency conversion. Each merchant operates in a single currency. If you need multi-currency support with conversion, you would need to:\n1. Add a currency conversion service (e.g., ExchangeRate API)\n2. Store exchange rates\n3. Convert amounts at redemption time",
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [

          },

            "lineNumber": 2
          },
          {
            "text": "Merchants can use any ISO 4217 currency code. The system supports all currencies that JavaScript's &#96;Intl.NumberFormat&#96; supports.",

          },
          {
            "text": "## Adding Currency Support",

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 6
          },
          {
            "text": "1. **Set merchant currency**:",
            "lineNumber": 7
          },
          {
            "text": "   When creating or updating a merchant, set the &#96;defaultCurrency&#96; field to the ISO 4217 code (e.g., \"EUR\", \"GBP\", \"JPY\").",

          {
            "lineNumber": 9
          },
          {
            "text": "2. **Currency formatting**:",
            "lineNumber": 10

            "text": "   The &#96;formatCurrency&#96; function in &#96;lib/utils.ts&#96; automatically formats currencies using the browser's locale-aware formatting:",
            "lineNumber": 11

            "text": "   &#96;&#96;&#96;typescript",
            "lineNumber": 12
          },
          {
            "text": "   formatCurrency(5000, 'EUR') // \"€50.00\" (in en-US locale)",
            "lineNumber": 13
          },
          {
            "text": "   formatCurrency(5000, 'JPY') // \"¥50\" (no decimals for JPY)",
            "lineNumber": 14
          },
          {
            "text": "   &#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 15
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 16
          },
          {
            "text": "3. **Database storage**:",
            "lineNumber": 17
          },
          {
            "text": "   All monetary amounts are stored in minor units (cents for USD, pence for GBP, etc.):",
            "lineNumber": 18
          },
          {
            "text": "   - USD: $5.00 = 500 (minor units)",
            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "text": "   - EUR: €5.00 = 500 (minor units)",
            "lineNumber": 20
          },
          {
            "text": "   - JPY: ¥50 = 50 (no minor units)",
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 22
          },
          {
            "text": "4. **Voucher creation**:",
            "lineNumber": 23
          },
          {
            "text": "   When creating a voucher, specify the currency:",

          },
          {
            "text": "   &#96;&#96;&#96;json",
            "lineNumber": 25
          },

            "lineNumber": 28
          },
          {
            "text": "     \"currency\": \"EUR\"",

          },

          {

          },
          {

    {
      "codeBlock": {

        "range": {

        },
        "contents": "export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {\nconst ;\n        if (!rateLimit.allowed) {\n          return NextResponse.json(\n            { error: 'Rate limit exceeded', remaining: rateLimit.remaining },\n            { status: 429 }\n          );\n        }\n      }\n    }\n\n    // Create redemption (unconfirmed initially)\n    const redemption = await prisma.redemption.create({\n      data: {\n        voucherId: voucher.id,\n        merchantId: voucher.merchantId,\n        referralId: data.referralId,\n        redeemedByUserId: session?.user?.id || null,\n        method: data.method,\n        orderReference: data.orderReference,\n        amountBeforeDiscount: data.amountBeforeDiscount,\n        discountApplied: data.discountApplied,\n        currency: data.currency,\n        confirmedAt: null,\n      },\n    });\n\n    // If there's a referral, create locked credit\n    if (data.referralId) {\n      const referral = await prisma.referral.findUnique({\n        where: { id: data.referralId },\n        include: { referrer: true },\n      });\n\n      if (referral) {\n        // Calculate credit amount (for MVP, use a fixed percentage or voucher value)\n        let creditAmount = 0;\n        if (voucher.type === 'credit_amount') {\n          creditAmount = voucher.value;\n        } else if (voucher.type === 'fixed_amount') {\n          creditAmount = voucher.value; // Same as discount\n        } else {\n          // Percentage: give 10% of discount as credit (configurable)\n          creditAmount = Math.floor(data.discountApplied * 0.1);\n        }\n\n        if (creditAmount &gt; 0) {\n          const expiresAt = new Date();\n          expiresAt.setDate(expiresAt.getDate() + 60); // Default 60 days\n\n          await prisma.creditLedger.create({\n            data: {\n              merchantId: voucher.merchantId,\n              userId: referral.referrerUserId,\n              amount: creditAmount,\n              currency: voucher.currency,\n              status: 'locked',\n              source: 'referral_redemption',\n              sourceId: redemption.id,\n              expiresAt,\n            },\n          });\n}",

        "contents": "export async function GET(req: NextRequest) {\n  try {\n    const session = await auth();\n    if (!session?.user?.id) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Unauthorized' }, { status: 401 });\n    }\n\n    const merchantSlug = req.nextUrl.searchParams.get('merchantSlug');\n    if (!merchantSlug) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Merchant slug required' }, { status: 400 });\n    }\n\n    const merchant = await prisma.merchant.findUnique({\n      where: { slug: merchantSlug },\n    });\n\n    if (!merchant) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Merchant not found' }, { status: 404 });\n    }\n\n    await requireMerchantRole(session.user.id, merchant.id, 'merchant_staff');\n\n    const redemptions = await prisma.redemption.findMany({\n      where: { merchantId: merchant.id },\n      include: {\n        voucher: {\n          select: { id: true, type: true },\n        },\n        referral: {\n          include: {\n            referrer: {\n              select: { name: true, email: true },\n            },\n          },\n        },\n      },\n      orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' },\n    });\n\n    // Generate CSV\n    const headers = [\n      'ID',\n      'Voucher ID',\n      'Voucher Type',\n      'Method',\n      'Order Reference',\n      'Amount Before Discount',\n      'Discount Applied',\n      'Currency',\n      'Referrer',\n      'Confirmed At',\n      'Created At',\n    ];\n\n    const rows = redemptions.map((r) =&gt; [\n      r.id,\n      r.voucher.id,\n      r.voucher.type,\n      r.method,\n      r.orderReference || '',\n      String(r.amountBeforeDiscount / 100),\n      String(r.discountApplied / 100),\n      r.currency,\n      r.referral?.referrer?.email || '',\n      r.confirmedAt ? new Date(r.confirmedAt).toISOString() : '',\n      new Date(r.createdAt).toISOString(),\n    ]);\n\n    const csv = [\n      headers.join(','),\n      ...rows.map((row) =&gt; row.map((cell) =&gt; &#96;\"${cell}\"&#96;).join(',')),\n    ].join('\\n');\n\n    return new NextResponse(csv,\n}",

        "contents": "import { auth } from '@/lib/auth';\nimport { prisma } from '@/lib/prisma';\nimport { hashFriendIdentifier } from '@/lib/utils';\nimport { checkReferralRateLimit } from '@/lib/fraud';\nimport { captureException } from '@/lib/error-tracking';\nimport { z } from 'zod';\n\nconst createReferralSchema = z.object({\n  voucherId: z.string(),\n  friendHint: z.string().optional(), // optional identifier hint for friend\n});\n\nexport async function POST(req: NextRequest) {\n  let voucherId: string | undefined;\n  try {\n    const session = await auth();\n    if (!session?.user?.id) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Unauthorized' }, { status: 401 });\n    }\n\n    const body = await req.json();\n    const parsed = createReferralSchema.parse(body);\n    voucherId = parsed.voucherId;\n    const { friendHint } = parsed;\n\n    // Get voucher\n    const voucher = await prisma.voucher.findUnique({\n      where: { id: parsed.voucherId },\n      include: { merchant: true },\n    });\n\n    if (!voucher) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Voucher not found' }, { status: 404 });\n    }\n\n    if (voucher.status !== 'published') {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Voucher not available' }, { status: 400 });\n    }\n\n    // Check rate limit\n    const rateLimit = await checkReferralRateLimit(session.user.id);\n    if (!rateLimit.allowed) {\n      return NextResponse.json(\n        { error: 'Rate limit exceeded', remaining: rateLimit.remaining },\n        { status: 429 }\n      );\n    }\n\n    // Hash friend identifier if provided\n    const friendHash = friendHint\n      ? await hashFriendIdentifier(friendHint)\n      : &#96;anonymous_${Date.now()}_${Math.random()}&#96;;\n\n    // Create referral\n    const referral = await prisma.referral.create({\n      data: {\n        voucherId: voucher.id,\n        merchantId: voucher.merchantId,\n        referrerUserId: session.user.id,\n        friendHash,\n        status: 'created',\n      },\n    });\n\n    // Generate share URL\n    const shareUrl = &#96;${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL}&#96;;\n}",

        "contents": "- &#96;POST /api/events/[id]/publish&#96; - Publish event\n- &#96;POST /api/events/[id]/generate-tickets&#96; - Generate tickets for event\n\n### Tickets\n\n- &#96;POST /api/tickets/[id]/purchase&#96; - Purchase ticket (Stripe checkout)\n\n### Referrals\n\n- &#96;POST /api/referrals/create&#96; - Create referral and get share URL\n\n### Redemptions\n\n- &#96;POST /api/redemptions&#96; - Create redemption\n- &#96;POST /api/redemptions/[id]/confirm&#96; - Confirm redemption (staff)\n\n### Credits\n\n- &#96;GET /api/wallet/[merchantSlug]&#96; - Get credit balance\n- &#96;POST /api/credits/apply&#96; - Apply credit to order\n\n### Weekly Drop\n\n- &#96;POST /api/weekly-drop/claim&#96; - Claim weekly drop stock\n\n## Database Schema\n\nKey models:\n\n- &#96;Merchant&#96;: Tenant information\n- &#96;User&#96;: Platform users\n- &#96;MerchantMember&#96;: User-merchant relationships with roles\n- &#96;Voucher&#96;: Voucher definitions\n- &#96;Campaign&#96;: Campaign definitions (pricing, limits, credit percentages)\n- &#96;VoucherPurchase&#96;: Voucher purchase records\n- &#96;Event&#96;: Event definitions\n- &#96;Ticket&#96;: Ticket instances for events\n- &#96;TicketPurchase&#96;: Ticket purchase records\n- &#96;Referral&#96;: Referral instances\n- &#96;Redemption&#96;: Redemption records\n- &#96;CreditLedger&#96;: Credit transactions\n- &#96;CreditUsage&#96;: Credit application records\n- &#96;AuditLog&#96;: Audit trail\n\nSee &#96;prisma/schema.prisma&#96; for full schema.\n\n## Business Rules\n\n1. **Credit is NOT cash**: Cannot be transferred or withdrawn\n2. **Per-merchant credits**: Credits are merchant-specific\n3. **Credit expiration**: Default 60 days (configurable per merchant)\n4. **Self-referral prevention**: Users cannot redeem their own referrals\n5. **Credit locking**: Credits start as LOCKED, unlock after redemption confirmation\n6. **Weekly drop stock**: Enforced atomically\n7. **Usage limits**: Total and per-user limits enforced\n\n## Testing\n\nRun tests:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\nnpm test\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Deployment\n\n### Environment Variables",

          {
            "text": "- &#96;Referral&#96;: Referral instances",
            "lineNumber": 238
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;Redemption&#96;: Redemption records",
            "lineNumber": 239
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;CreditLedger&#96;: Credit transactions",
            "lineNumber": 240
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;CreditUsage&#96;: Credit application records",
            "lineNumber": 241
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;AuditLog&#96;: Audit trail",
            "lineNumber": 242
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 243
          },
          {
            "text": "See &#96;prisma/schema.prisma&#96; for full schema.",
            "lineNumber": 244
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 245
          },
          {
            "text": "## Business Rules",
            "lineNumber": 246
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 247
          },
          {
            "text": "1. **Credit is NOT cash**: Cannot be transferred or withdrawn",
            "lineNumber": 248
          },
          {
            "text": "2. **Per-merchant credits**: Credits are merchant-specific",
            "lineNumber": 249
          },
          {
            "text": "3. **Credit expiration**: Default 60 days (configurable per merchant)",
            "lineNumber": 250
          },
          {
            "text": "4. **Self-referral prevention**: Users cannot redeem their own referrals",
            "lineNumber": 251
          },
          {
            "text": "5. **Credit locking**: Credits start as LOCKED, unlock after redemption confirmation",
            "lineNumber": 252
          },
          {
            "text": "6. **Weekly drop stock**: Enforced atomically",
            "lineNumber": 253
          },
          {
            "text": "7. **Usage limits**: Total and per-user limits enforced",
            "lineNumber": 254
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 255
          },
          {
            "text": "## Testing",
            "lineNumber": 256
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 257
          },
          {
            "text": "Run tests:",
            "lineNumber": 258
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 259
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 260
          },
          {
            "text": "npm test",
            "lineNumber": 261
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 262
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 263
          },
          {

            "lineNumber": 264
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 265
          },
          {
            "text": "### Environment Variables",
            "lineNumber": 266
          }
        ]

        "contents": "# Deployment Guide\n\n## Pre-Deployment Checklist\n\n- [ ] All environment variables configured\n- [ ] Database migrations run\n- [ ] Seed data loaded (if needed)\n- [ ] SMTP configured for email magic links\n- [ ] OAuth providers configured (if using)\n- [ ] PWA icons generated (192x192 and 512x512 PNG)\n- [ ] Object storage configured (for brand assets)\n- [ ] Redis configured (for rate limiting in production)\n\n## Environment Variables\n\nRequired for production:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# App\nNODE_ENV=production\nNEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL=https://your-domain.com\n\n# Database\nDATABASE_URL=postgresql://user:password@host:5432/dbname\n\n# Redis (recommended for production caching and rate limiting)\nREDIS_URL=redis://host:6379\n\n# Error Tracking (Sentry - optional but recommended)\nNEXT_PUBLIC_SENTRY_DSN=https://your-sentry-dsn@sentry.io/project-id\n\n# Cron Jobs\nCRON_SECRET=&lt;generate-random-32-chars-for-cron-authentication&gt;\n\n# Auth\nAUTH_SECRET=&lt;generate-random-32-chars&gt;\nNEXTAUTH_URL=https://your-domain.com\nNEXTAUTH_SECRET=&lt;generate-random-32-chars&gt;\n\n# OAuth (optional)\nGOOGLE_CLIENT_ID=\nGOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET=\nAPPLE_CLIENT_ID=\nAPPLE_CLIENT_SECRET=\nAPPLE_TEAM_ID=\nAPPLE_KEY_ID=\n\n# Email\nSMTP_HOST=smtp.example.com\nSMTP_PORT=587\nSMTP_USER=noreply@your-domain.com\nSMTP_PASSWORD=\nSMTP_FROM=noreply@your-domain.com\n\n# Object Storage (S3 compatible)\nS3_ENDPOINT=\nS3_ACCESS_KEY_ID=\nS3_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=\nS3_BUCKET=\nS3_REGION=\n\n# Platform Admin\nPLATFORM_ADMIN_EMAILS=admin@your-domain.com\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Deployment Options\n\n### Vercel (Recommended)\n\n1. **Connect repository** to Vercel\n2. **Configure environment variables** in Vercel dashboard\n3. **Set build command**: &#96;npm run build&#96;\n4. **Set output directory**: &#96;.next&#96;\n5. **Database**: Use Vercel Postgres or external provider\n6. **Redis**: Use Upstash Redis or external provider\n\n### Render\n\n1. **Create new Web Service**\n2. **Connect repository**\n3. **Build command**: &#96;npm run build&#96;\n4. **Start command**: &#96;npm start&#96;\n5. **Environment**: Add all environment variables\n6. **Database**: Create PostgreSQL service",

        "contents": "export async function PUT(\n  req: NextRequest,\n  { params }: { params: { slug: string; id: string } }\n) {\n new Date(data.validFrom);\n    if (data.validTo !== undefined) updateData.validTo = new Date(data.validTo);\n    if (data.usageLimitTotal !== undefined) updateData.usageLimitTotal = data.usageLimitTotal;\n    if (data.usageLimitPerUser !== undefined) updateData.usageLimitPerUser = data.usageLimitPerUser;\n    if (data.weeklyDropEnabled !== undefined) updateData.weeklyDropEnabled = data.weeklyDropEnabled;\n    if (data.weeklyDropJson !== undefined) {\n      updateData.weeklyDropJson = data.weeklyDropJson ? JSON.stringify(data.weeklyDropJson) : Prisma.DbNull;\n    }\n    if (data.conditionsJson !== undefined) {\n      updateData.conditionsJson = data.conditionsJson ? JSON.stringify(data.conditionsJson) : Prisma.DbNull;\n    }\n    if (data.designJson !== undefined) {\n      updateData.designJson = data.designJson ? JSON.stringify(data.designJson) : Prisma.DbNull;\n    }\n    if (data.codePrefix !== undefined) updateData.codePrefix = data.codePrefix;\n\n    const updated = await prisma.voucher.update({\n      where: { id: params.id },\n      data: updateData,\n    });\n\n    // Log audit\n    await prisma.auditLog.create({\n      data: {\n        merchantId: merchant.id,\n        actorUserId: session.user.id,\n        action: 'voucher.updated',\n        payloadJson: JSON.stringify({ voucherId: params.id, changes: Object.keys(updateData) }),\n      },\n    });\n\n    return NextResponse.json(updated);\n  } catch (error) {\n    if (error instanceof z.ZodError) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: error.errors }, { status: 400 });\n    }\n    console.error('Error updating voucher:', error);\n    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Internal server error' }, { status: 500 });\n  }\n}\n\nexport async function GET(\n  req: NextRequest,\n  { params }: { params: { slug: string; id: string } }\n) {\n  \n}",

        "relativeWorkspacePath": ".\\app\\api\\weekly-drop\\claim\\route.ts",
        "range": {

        "contents": "export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {\n\n\n    if (!weeklyDrop) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Weekly drop configuration missing' }, { status: 400 });\n    }\n\n    // Check if we're in the drop window\n    const now = new Date();\n    const dayOfWeek = now.getDay();\n    const [hours, minutes] = weeklyDrop.startTime.split(':').map(Number);\n    const startTime = new Date(now);\n    startTime.setHours(hours, minutes, 0, 0);\n    const endTime = new Date(startTime);\n    endTime.setMinutes(endTime.getMinutes() + weeklyDrop.durationMinutes);\n\n    if (dayOfWeek !== weeklyDrop.dayOfWeek || now &lt; startTime || now &gt; endTime) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Weekly drop not active' }, { status: 400 });\n    }\n\n    // Atomically check stock and create referral\n    const result = await prisma.$transaction(async (tx) =&gt; {\n      // Count existing referrals for this voucher created in this drop window\n      const existingCount = await tx.referral.count({\n        where: {\n          voucherId: voucher.id,\n          createdAt: {\n            gte: startTime,\n            lte: endTime,\n          },\n        },\n      });\n\n      if (existingCount &gt;= weeklyDrop.stock) {\n        throw new Error('Weekly drop sold out');\n      }\n\n      // Create referral\n      const friendHash = friendHint\n        ? await hashFriendIdentifier(friendHint)\n        : &#96;anonymous_${Date.now()}_${Math.random()}&#96;;\n\n      const referral = await tx.referral.create({\n        data: {\n          voucherId: voucher.id,\n          merchantId: voucher.merchantId,\n          referrerUserId: session.user.id,\n          friendHash,\n          status: 'created',\n        },\n      });\n\n      return referral;\n    });\n\n    const shareUrl = &#96;${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL}/r/${result.id}&#96;;\n\n    return NextResponse.json({\n      referralId: result.id,\n      shareUrl,\n      remaining: weeklyDrop.stock - 1, // Approximate\n    });\n  } catch (error)\n}",

        "contents": "---\nname: voucher\ndescription: This is a new rule\n---\n\n# Voucher Rules\n\n## 0) SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH\n\nAinus tõde on TOTAL / ALL-IN PROMPT + MVP UI Scope-lock + Business Rules.\n\nKui miski on vastuolus → ära ehita.\n\nKüsimuse korral → küsi enne.\n\n## 1) MVP SCOPE ON LUKUS\n\nEHITADA TOHIB AINULT:\n\nVoucher → Referral → Redemption → Credit → Wallet\n\nPublic pages ilma login’ita\n\nMerchant dashboard minimaalses mahus\n\nKEELATUD MVP-S:\n\nmarketplace\n\nfeed\n\nkommentaarid / like’id\n\nloyalty tiers / badges\n\nads\n\nAI\n\ngrowth-hackid\n\nextra analytics\n\nKui funktsioon ei aita jagada, lunastada või krediteerida, siis ära ehita.\n\n## 2) TECH STACK ON LUKUS\n\nNext.js (App Router)\n\nTypeScript kõikjal\n\nPrisma + PostgreSQL\n\nshadcn/ui + Tailwind\n\nPWA (manifest + service worker)\n\nnext-intl (EN default)\n\nEi mingeid:\n\nteisi frameworke\n\ncustom CSS süsteeme\n\nteisi ORM-e\n\nparoolipõhist auth’i\n\n## 3) ROLLID &amp; ÕIGUSED (RANGE)\n\nanonymous → ainult public pages\n\nuser → ainult enda wallet &amp; vouchers\n\nmerchant_staff → redemption confirm\n\nmerchant_admin → voucherid, settings\n\nplatform_admin → audit &amp; risk\n\nReegel:\nUI võib peita, server peab alati kontrollima.\n\n## 4) PUBLIC PAGES REEGEL (KRIITILINE)\n\n/v/[voucherId] ja /r/[referralId]:\n\nEI TOHI nõuda login’it\n\nPEAVAD avanema &lt;1s\n\nPEAVAD töötama mobiilis ideaalselt\n\nJagamine peab olema 1 tap.\n\n## 5) BUSINESS RULES (MITTEVAIDLUSTATAV)\n\nCredit ≠ raha\n\nCredit on merchant-põhine\n\nCredit:\n\nalgul locked\n\navailable ainult pärast redemption confirm\n\naegub\n\nSelf-referral on keelatud\n\nWeekly Drop:\n\nlimited stock\n\nfirst-come-first-served\n\nkui otsas → otsas\n\n## 6) DATA &amp; TRANSACTIONS\n\nKõik write’id:\n\ntransaction’iga\n\nserver-side validatsioon\n\nÄra salvesta:\n\nraw phone/email (hash ainult)\n\nPrisma schema = püha\n\nÄra kasuta JSON-i, kui on vaja relatsiooni (v.a designJson, conditionsJson).\n\n## 7) UI &amp; UX REEGLID\n\n1 primary CTA per vaade\n\nMobile-first (desktop = enhancement)\n\nEi mingeid “wizard’eid” üle 2 sammu\n\nEi mingeid modal-hell’e\n\nCredit peab tunduma päris väärtusena",
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [

        "contents": "import { auth } from '@/lib/auth';\nimport { applyCredit } from '@/lib/credits';\nimport { getMerchantBySlug } from '@/lib/tenant';\nimport { z } from 'zod';\n\nconst applyCreditSchema = z.object({\n  merchantSlug: z.string(),\n  amount: z.number().int().positive(),\n  orderReference: z.string().optional(),\n});\n\nexport async function POST(req: NextRequest) {\n  try {\n    const session = await auth();\n    if (!session?.user?.id) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Unauthorized' }, { status: 401 });\n    }\n\n    const body = await req.json();\n    const { merchantSlug, amount, orderReference } = applyCreditSchema.parse(body);\n\n    const merchant = await getMerchantBySlug(merchantSlug);\n    if (!merchant) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Merchant not found' }, { status: 404 });\n    }\n\n    const result = await applyCredit(session.user.id, merchant.id, amount, orderReference || '');\n\n    return NextResponse.json(result);\n  } catch (error) {\n    if (error instanceof z.ZodError) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: error.errors }, { status: 400 });\n    }\n    if (error instanceof Error &amp;&amp; error.message === 'Insufficient credit balance') {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: error.message }, { status: 400 });\n    }\n    console.error('Error applying credit:', error);\n    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Internal server error' }, { status: 500 });\n  }\n}",

   - Reopen the workspace
3. Check for very large files or data structures that might be causing serialization issues.
4. Update Cursor to the latest version.
5. If it persists, report it to Cursor support with the error details.

JSON.parse(x) : x ?? undefined);\n      const designJson = v.designJson != null ? parse(v.designJson) : undefined;\n      const weeklyDropJson = v.weeklyDropJson != null ? parse(v.weeklyDropJson) : undefined;\n      const conditionsJson = v.conditionsJson != null ? parse(v.conditionsJson) : undefined;\n\n      const body = {\n        type: v.type,\n        value: v.value,\n        currency: v.currency,\n        validFrom: new Date(v.validFrom).toISOString(),\n        validTo: new Date(v.validTo).toISOString(),\n        usageLimitTotal: v.usageLimitTotal ?? undefined,\n        usageLimitPerUser: v.usageLimitPerUser ?? undefined,\n        weeklyDropEnabled: v.weeklyDropEnabled ?? false,\n        weeklyDropJson: weeklyDropJson ?? undefined,\n        conditionsJson: conditionsJson ?? undefined,\n        designJson,\n        codePrefix: v.codePrefix ?? undefined,\n      };\n\n      const postRes = await fetch(&#96;/api/merchant/${slug}/vouchers&#96;, {\n        method: 'POST',\n        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },\n        body: JSON.stringify(body),\n      });\n      if (!postRes.ok) {\n        const d = await postRes.json().catch(() =&gt; ({}));\n        throw new Error(d.error || 'Failed to duplicate');\n      }\n      const created = await postRes.json();\n      showSuccess('Voucher duplicated');\n      router.push(&#96;/merchant/${slug}/vouchers/${created.id}&#96;);\n    } catch (e) {\n      showError(e instanceof Error ? e.message : 'Failed to duplicate');\n    } finally {\n      setDuplicating(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  return (\n    &lt;div className=\"flex items-center gap-1\"&gt;\n}",

        "contents": "export default function ReferralClient({\n  referral,\n  voucher,\n  design,\n  brandColors,\n  voucherCode,\n  qrCodeDataUrl,\n  isSelfReferral,\n}: ReferralClientProps) {\n\n\n  const calculateDiscount = (amount: number) =&gt; {\n    if (voucher.type === 'percentage') {\n      return Math.floor((amount * voucher.value) / 10000);\n    }\n    return Math.min(voucher.value, amount);\n  };\n\n  const handleRedeem = async (method: 'online' | 'in_store') =&gt; {\n    if (isSelfReferral) {\n      setError(tReferral('cannotRedeemOwn'));\n      return;\n    }\n    setIsRedeeming(true);\n    setError('');\n    try {\n      const amount = method === 'online' ? parseInt(orderAmount, 10) * 100 : 10000;\n      const discount = calculateDiscount(amount);\n      const response = await fetch('/api/redemptions', {\n        method: 'POST',\n        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },\n        body: JSON.stringify({\n          voucherId: voucher.id,\n          referralId: referral.id,\n          method,\n          amountBeforeDiscount: amount,\n          discountApplied: discount,\n          currency: voucher.currency,\n        }),\n      });\n      const data = await response.json();\n      if (!response.ok) throw new Error(data.error || tReferral('redemptionFailed'));\n      if (method === 'in_store') {\n        showSuccess(tReferral('showQrToStaff'));\n        qrRef.current?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });\n      } else {\n        showSuccess(tReferral('discountApplied', { amount: formatCurrency(discount, voucher.currency) }));\n      }\n      router.refresh();\n    } catch (err: unknown) {\n      setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : tReferral('redemptionFailed'));\n    } finally {\n      setIsRedeeming(false);\n    }\n  };\n}",

        "contents": "interface VoucherClientProps {\n;\n  voucherCode: string;\n  qrCodeDataUrl: string;\n  isAuthenticated: boolean;\n  campaign?: any;\n}\n\nexport default function VoucherClient({\n  voucher,\n  design,\n  brandColors,\n  voucherCode,\n  qrCodeDataUrl,\n  isAuthenticated,\n  campaign,\n}: VoucherClientProps) {\n  const [isSharing, setIsSharing] = useState(false);\n  const [got, setGot] = useState(false);\n  const [isPurchasing, setIsPurchasing] = useState(false);\n  const t = useTranslations('payment');\n  const tVoucher = useTranslations('voucher');\n  const tCommon = useTranslations('common');\n  const tSuccess = useTranslations('success');\n\n  const brandBg = brandColors?.background || design?.backgroundColor || '#fafafa';\n  const brandPrimary = brandColors?.primary || design?.primaryColor || '#18181b';\n  \n  const hasPrice = campaign?.price !== null &amp;&amp; campaign?.price !== undefined;\n  const price = campaign?.price || 0;\n\n  const handleGet = async () =&gt; {\n    await navigator.clipboard.writeText(voucherCode);\n    showSuccess(t('codeCopied'));\n    setGot(true);\n    setTimeout(() =&gt; setGot(false), 1500);\n  };\n\n  const handlePurchase = async () =&gt; {\n    if (!isAuthenticated) {\n      window.location.href = &#96;/login?callbackUrl=${encodeURIComponent(window.location.href)}&#96;;\n      return;\n    }\n\n    setIsPurchasing(true);\n    try {\n      const res = await fetch(&#96;/api/vouchers/${voucher.id}/purchase&#96;, {\n        method: 'POST',\n        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },\n        body: JSON.stringify({}),\n      });\n\n      if (!res.ok) {\n        const error = await res.json();\n        throw new Error(error.error || t('purchaseFailed'));\n      }\n\n      const data = await res.json();\n      if (data.url) {\n        window.location.href = data.url;\n      } else {\n        throw new Error(t('purchaseFailed'));\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      showError(error instanceof Error ? error.message : t('purchaseFailed'));\n      setIsPurchasing(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  const handleShare = async () =&gt; {\n    setIsSharing(true);\n;\n}",

        "contents": "import { auth } from '@/lib/auth';\nimport { applyCredit } from '@/lib/credits';\nimport { getMerchantBySlug } from '@/lib/tenant';\nimport { z } from 'zod';\n\nconst applyCreditSchema = z.object({\n  merchantSlug: z.string(),\n  amount: z.number().int().positive(),\n  orderReference: z.string().optional(),\n});\n\nexport async function POST(req: NextRequest) {\n  try {\n    const session = await auth();\n    if (!session?.user?.id) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Unauthorized' }, { status: 401 });\n    }\n\n    const body = await req.json();\n    const { merchantSlug, amount, orderReference } = applyCreditSchema.parse(body);\n\n    const merchant = await getMerchantBySlug(merchantSlug);\n    if (!merchant) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Merchant not found' }, { status: 404 });\n    }\n\n    const result = await applyCredit(session.user.id, merchant.id, amount, orderReference || '');\n\n    return NextResponse.json(result);\n  } catch (error) {\n    if (error instanceof z.ZodError) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: error.errors }, { status: 400 });\n    }\n    if (error instanceof Error &amp;&amp; error.message === 'Insufficient credit balance') {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: error.message }, { status: 400 });\n    }\n    console.error('Error applying credit:', error);\n    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Internal server error' }, { status: 500 });\n  }\n}",

    {
      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": ".\\app\\api\\redemptions\\route.ts",
        "range": {
          "startPosition": {
            "column": 56
          },
          "endPosition": {
            "line": 179,
            "column": 1
          }
        },
        "contents": "import { auth } from '@/lib/auth';\nimport { prisma } from '@/lib/prisma';\nimport { checkRedemptionRateLimit, isSelfReferral, checkIPRateLimit } from '@/lib/fraud';\nimport { requireActiveMerchant } from '@/lib/merchant-status';\nimport { captureException } from '@/lib/error-tracking';\nimport { z } from 'zod';\n\nconst createRedemptionSchema = z.object({\n  voucherId: z.string(),\n  referralId: z.string().optional(),\n  method: z.enum(['online', 'in_store']),\n  orderReference: z.string().optional(),\n  amountBeforeDiscount: z.number().int().positive(),\n  discountApplied: z.number().int().nonnegative(),\n  currency: z.string(),\n});\n\nexport async function POST(req: NextRequest) {\n  try {\n    // IP-based rate limiting for public redemptions\n    const ip = req.headers.get('x-forwarded-for')?.split(',')[0] || \n               req.headers.get('x-real-ip') || \n               'unknown';\n    const ipRateLimit = checkIPRateLimit(ip, 60, 50); // 50 per hour per IP\n    if (!ipRateLimit.allowed) {\n      return NextResponse.json(\n        { error: 'Rate limit exceeded', remaining: ipRateLimit.remaining },\n        { status: 429 }\n      );\n    }\n\n    const session = await auth();\n    const body = await req.json();\n    const data = createRedemptionSchema.parse(body);\n\n    // Get voucher\n    const voucher = await prisma.voucher.findUnique({\n      where: { id: data.voucherId },\n      include: { merchant: true },\n    });\n\n    if (!voucher) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Voucher not found' }, { status: 404 });\n    }\n\n    // Check merchant is active (kill switch)\n    try {\n      await requireActiveMerchant(voucher.merchantId);\n    } catch (error) {\n      if (error instanceof Error &amp;&amp; error.message?.includes('inactive')) {\n        return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Merchant is inactive' }, { status: 403 });\n      }\n      throw error;\n    }\n\n    if (voucher.status !== 'published')\n}",

        "contents": "import { auth } from '@/lib/auth';\nimport { prisma } from '@/lib/prisma';\nimport { hashFriendIdentifier } from '@/lib/utils';\nimport { checkReferralRateLimit } from '@/lib/fraud';\nimport { captureException } from '@/lib/error-tracking';\nimport { z } from 'zod';\n\nconst createReferralSchema = z.object({\n  voucherId: z.string(),\n  friendHint: z.string().optional(), // optional identifier hint for friend\n});\n\nexport async function POST(req: NextRequest) {\n  let voucherId: string | undefined;\n  try {\n    const session = await auth();\n    if (!session?.user?.id) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Unauthorized' }, { status: 401 });\n    }\n\n    const body = await req.json();\n    const parsed = createReferralSchema.parse(body);\n    voucherId = parsed.voucherId;\n    const { friendHint } = parsed;\n\n    // Get voucher\n    const voucher = await prisma.voucher.findUnique({\n      where: { id: parsed.voucherId },\n      include: { merchant: true },\n    });\n\n    if (!voucher) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Voucher not found' }, { status: 404 });\n    }\n\n    if (voucher.status !== 'published') {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Voucher not available' }, { status: 400 });\n    }\n\n    // Check rate limit\n    const rateLimit = await checkReferralRateLimit(session.user.id);\n    if (!rateLimit.allowed) {\n      return NextResponse.json(\n        { error: 'Rate limit exceeded', remaining: rateLimit.remaining },\n        { status: 429 }\n      );\n    }\n\n    // Hash friend identifier if provided\n    const friendHash = friendHint\n      ? await hashFriendIdentifier(friendHint)\n      : &#96;anonymous_${Date.now()}_${Math.random()}&#96;;\n\n    // Create referral\n    const referral = await prisma.referral.create({\n      data: {\n        voucherId: voucher.id,\n        merchantId: voucher.merchantId,\n        referrerUserId: session.user.id,\n        friendHash,\n        status: 'created',\n      },\n    });\n\n    // Generate share URL\n    const shareUrl = &#96;${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL}&#96;;\n}",

        "contents": "'use client';\n\nimport { useState, useEffect } from 'react';\nimport { useParams } from 'next/navigation';\nimport { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';\nimport { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';\nimport { Label } from '@/components/ui/label';\nimport { Card, CardContent, CardDescription, CardHeader, CardTitle } from '@/components/ui/card';\nimport { formatCurrency } from '@/lib/utils';\n\nexport default function CheckoutDemoPage() {\n  const params = useParams();\n  const merchantSlug = params.merchantSlug as string;\n  const [orderAmount, setOrderAmount] = useState('');\n  const [creditAmount, setCreditAmount] = useState('');\n  const [balance, setBalance] = useState&lt;any&gt;(null);\n  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false);\n  const [error, setError] = useState('');\n\n  useEffect(() =&gt; {\n    fetch(&#96;/api/wallet/${merchantSlug}&#96;)\n      .then((res) =&gt; res.json())\n      .then((data) =&gt; {\n        setBalance(data);\n        if (data.available &gt; 0) {\n          setCreditAmount(String(data.available / 100));\n        }\n      })\n      .catch((err) =&gt; {\n        console.error('Error fetching balance:', err);\n      });\n  }, [merchantSlug]);\n\n  const handleApplyCredit = async () =&gt;\n;\n}",

## Summary

**Problem**: `TypeError: e[o] is not a function` during page generation. Prisma `Json` fields are already deserialized, but the code was calling `JSON.parse()` on them, causing errors when the value was already an object.

**Solution**: Added a `safeParseJson` helper that handles both strings and objects, and replaced all `JSON.parse()` calls on Prisma Json fields.

## Files Changed

1. **`lib/utils.ts`** - Added `safeParseJson` helper function
2. **`app/v/[id]/page.tsx`** - Fixed designJson and brandColorsJson parsing
3. **`app/r/[id]/page.tsx`** - Fixed designJson and brandColorsJson parsing
4. **`app/merchant/[slug]/vouchers/voucher-row-actions.tsx`** - Fixed JSON parsing in duplicate handler
5. **`app/admin/page.tsx`** - Fixed payloadJson parsing
6. **`app/api/weekly-drop/claim/route.ts`** - Fixed weeklyDropJson parsing
7. **`app/merchant/[slug]/vouchers/[id]/edit-voucher-form.tsx`** - Fixed designJson and weeklyDropJson parsing
8. **`app/merchant/[slug]/vouchers/vouchers-list-client.tsx`** - Fixed designJson parsing (3 instances)
9. **`app/api/tickets/[id]/purchase/route.ts`** - Fixed ticketTypesJson parsing
10. **`app/merchant/[slug]/onboarding/page.tsx`** - Fixed brandColorsJson parsing
11. **`app/app/[merchantSlug]/vouchers/page.tsx`** - Fixed designJson parsing
12. **`app/merchant/[slug]/settings/page.tsx`** - Fixed brandColorsJson parsing
13. **`app/e/[id]/page.tsx`** - Fixed brandColorsJson parsing
14. **`app/tickets/[id]/page.tsx`** - Fixed brandColorsJson parsing

## Testing Steps

1. Restart the Next.js dev server
2. Navigate to any page that uses vouchers, events, or merchant branding
3. Verify pages render without the serialization error
4. Check browser console for any remaining errors

The `safeParseJson` function safely handles:
- `null`/`undefined` → returns `null`
- String values → parses with `JSON.parse` (with error handling)
- Object values → returns as-is (already parsed by Prisma)

This should resolve the error.

**Olek:**
- Docker Desktop töötab

**Järgmised sammud:**

Server peaks mõne sekundi jooksul valmis olema. Kui on probleeme, anna teada.
